sloka: निर्द्धूतान् वायुना पश्य विततान् पुष्पसञ्चयान् ।पोप्लूयमानानपरान् पश्य त्वं जलमध्यगान् ॥ २.९५.१०॥
transliteration: nirddhūtān vāyunā paśya vitatān puṣpasañcayān ।poplūyamānānaparān paśya tvaṁ jalamadhyagān ॥ 2.95.10॥

translations.english: Look at the scattered heaps of flowers shaken off by the wind and large quantities of flowers floating on the waters.
